name: Ticket
description: Primary entity representing support tickets with complete lifecycle tracking from submission to closure

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique identifier for the ticket

fields.name: ticketNumber
fields.description: Human-readable ticket number (e.g., TKT-2024-001)

fields.name: title
fields.description: Brief summary of the ticket issue

fields.name: description
fields.description: Detailed description of the issue or request

fields.name: status
fields.description: Current status of the ticket (New, Assigned, In Progress, Resolved, Closed)

fields.name: priority
fields.description: Priority level of the ticket (Low, Medium, High, Critical)

fields.name: category
fields.description: Category or type of the ticket (Technical, HR, Access, Other)

fields.name: submittedBy
fields.description: User ID or name of the person who submitted the ticket

name: User
description: Store user information for customers, agents, and managers with role-based access control

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique identifier for the user

fields.name: email
fields.description: User's email address for authentication and communication

fields.name: firstName
fields.description: User's first name

fields.name: lastName
fields.description: User's last name

fields.name: role
fields.description: User role for access control: customer, agent, or manager

fields.name: department
fields.description: Department the user belongs to

fields.name: isActive
fields.description: Indicates if the user account is active

fields.name: lastLoginAt
fields.description: Timestamp of the user's last login

relationships.description: Agent can be assigned to multiple tickets

email.message: Must be a valid email address

role.message: Role must be customer, agent, or manager

name: Category
description: Lookup table for ticket categorization enabling proper routing and organization by department or issue type

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique identifier for the category

fields.name: name
fields.description: Display name of the category

fields.name: description
fields.description: Detailed description of what issues belong to this category

fields.name: department
fields.description: Department responsible for handling tickets in this category

fields.name: defaultAssigneeId
fields.description: Default user ID to assign tickets in this category

fields.name: isActive
fields.description: Indicates if the category is currently active and available for selection

fields.name: createdAt
fields.description: Timestamp when the category was created

fields.name: updatedAt
fields.description: Timestamp when the category was last updated

relationships.description: A category can be assigned to multiple tickets
A category has a default assignee user

validations.name: Must be between 2 and 100 characters
validations.department: Must be a valid department name

name: SLA
description: Service level agreement configurations defining response and resolution time targets based on priority and category

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique identifier for the SLA configuration

fields.name: categoryId
fields.description: Reference to the ticket category this SLA applies to

fields.name: priority
fields.description: Priority level this SLA applies to (e.g., Low, Medium, High, Critical)

fields.name: responseTimeMinutes
fields.description: Target time in minutes for initial response to ticket

fields.name: resolutionTimeMinutes
fields.description: Target time in minutes for complete ticket resolution

fields.name: escalationTimeMinutes
fields.description: Time in minutes before ticket is escalated if not addressed

fields.name: isActive
fields.description: Indicates whether this SLA configuration is currently active

relationships.description: Links SLA to specific ticket category

constraints.uniqueCategoryPriority: Each category-priority combination must have only one active SLA
constraints.positiveTimeValues: All time values must be positive numbers

name: Comment
description: Store communication thread for each ticket, maintaining conversation history between customers and agents

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique identifier for the comment

fields.name: ticketId
fields.description: Reference to the parent ticket

fields.name: userId
fields.description: Reference to the user who created the comment

fields.name: commentText
fields.description: The actual comment or response content

fields.name: isInternal
fields.description: Flag indicating if comment is internal note (visible only to agents) or public

fields.name: attachmentCount
fields.description: Number of files attached to this comment

fields.name: createdAt
fields.description: Timestamp when the comment was created

fields.name: updatedAt
fields.description: Timestamp when the comment was last modified

relationships.description: Each comment belongs to one ticket
Each comment is created by one user

indexes.name: idx_ticket_created
indexes.description: Optimize retrieval of comments for a ticket in chronological order

indexes.name: idx_user_comments
indexes.description: Optimize retrieval of all comments by a specific user

constraints.commentTextLength: commentText must be between 1 and 10000 characters
constraints.validTicketReference: ticketId must reference an existing Ticket
constraints.validUserReference: userId must reference an existing User

name: Attachment
description: Store file attachments for tickets and comments with metadata for file management and retrieval

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique identifier for the attachment

fields.name: ticketId
fields.description: Reference to the ticket this attachment belongs to

fields.name: commentId
fields.description: Reference to the comment this attachment belongs to (null if attached directly to ticket)

fields.name: fileName
fields.description: Original name of the uploaded file

fields.name: fileSize
fields.description: Size of the file in bytes

fields.name: fileType
fields.description: MIME type of the file (e.g., image/png, application/pdf)

fields.name: filePath
fields.description: Storage path or URL where the file is stored

fields.name: uploadedBy
fields.description: Reference to the user who uploaded the attachment

fields.name: uploadedAt
fields.description: Timestamp when the file was uploaded

relationships.description: Each attachment belongs to one ticket
Each attachment may belong to one comment
Each attachment is uploaded by one user

constraints.maxFileSize: Maximum file size enforced at application level
constraints.allowedFileTypes: Restricted file types enforced at application level for security

name: TicketHistory
description: Audit log tracking all changes to tickets including status changes, assignments, priority updates, and field modifications

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique identifier for the history entry

fields.name: ticketId
fields.description: Reference to the ticket that was modified

fields.name: changedBy
fields.description: User ID of the person who made the change

fields.name: changeType
fields.description: Type of change (status_change, assignment, priority_update, field_modification)

fields.name: fieldName
fields.description: Name of the field that was changed

fields.name: oldValue
fields.description: Previous value before the change

fields.name: newValue
fields.description: New value after the change

fields.name: changedAt
fields.description: Timestamp when the change occurred

relationships.description: Each history entry belongs to one ticket
Each history entry is created by one user

name: Notification
description: Track notification delivery status for email and in-app notifications with retry management

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique identifier for the notification

fields.name: ticketId
fields.description: Reference to the related ticket

fields.name: userId
fields.description: Reference to the recipient user

fields.name: channel
fields.description: Delivery channel (email, in-app)

fields.name: subject
fields.description: Notification subject line

fields.name: status
fields.description: Delivery status (pending, sent, failed, read)

fields.name: sentAt
fields.description: Timestamp when notification was sent

fields.name: retryCount
fields.description: Number of delivery retry attempts

relationships.description: Notification is sent to a user
